sloka: मम ऊरु जन्घा वेगेन भविष्यति समुत्थितः ।समुत्थित महा ग्राहः समुद्रो वरुण आलयः ॥४-६७-१३॥
transliteration: mama ūru janghā vegena bhaviṣyati samutthitaḥ ।samutthita mahā grāhaḥ samudro varuṇa ālayaḥ ॥4-67-13॥

translations.english: 'Thrust by my thighs,the ocean will rise up, carrying with it the shanks and mighty crocodiles stunned by the force.
